title: How Light Upon Light Started: Denied a Cup of Tea
excerpt: Light Upon Light began in Washington after Founder & CEO Ronahi Zebari was denied a cup of tea because of her disability—and decided dignity would never be optional again.
body:
Light Upon Light is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Redmond, Washington (EIN 99-2690459).

Our story did not begin in a boardroom.

It began with a cup of tea.

Founder & CEO Ronahi Zebari was denied something that simple because of her disability. That moment revealed how often differently-abled people are overlooked in ordinary spaces.

In 2024, she founded Light Upon Light to advance advocacy, accessibility, education, and equality—so dignity is never treated as optional.

Today, Light Upon Light serves communities through programs like Enlighten, Big Light Little Light, Signs of Our Light, and more.

Official website: https://thelightuponlight.org/

If you are searching for Light Upon Light, the disability advocacy nonprofit in Washington led by Ronahi Zebari, you are in the right place.
